inputs.usage: Use only actual playfield sprites for pixel-art construction cues; do not copy faces, clothes, poses, pixels, UI, HUD, or environment.

prompt:
Use case: style-transfer
Asset type: single original full-body 2D beat-'em-up game sprite concept, presented enlarged for review.
Input images: Image 1 is STYLE-ONLY gameplay reference/support. Use only the actual gameplay characters in its playfield for pixel-art construction cues. Do NOT copy any character face, clothing, pose, pixels, UI, HUD, or environment from it.
Primary request: Replace the scene with ONE ORIGINAL isolated game character: a young South Indian-inspired light-armor fighter with a long low ponytail.
Subject: adult early-mid-20s male, lean athletic but strongly stylized as a compact grown-man beat-'em-up sprite. About 4–4.5 heads tall, NOT 6–8 heads tall; modest head around 26–30 logical pixels; small adult eyes, visible clear simple face, recognizable jaw, subtle dark pixel-stubble cluster. Warm medium-light brown skin. Near-black hair, exposed face and hairline, in 4–6 broad graphic locks, gathered into a long low nape ponytail reaching the upper back.
Outfit: simple indigo short-sleeved cloth top; one broad charcoal light chest protector with a clear simple chest plane; exactly one tapered worn-steel forearm guard with central ridge; small rust waist tie; short waist cloth over fitted charcoal trousers; short dark boots; compact straight one-handed sword sheathed at the hip. Functional subtle-future construction only. No extra straps, long tassels, cape, hood, magic, neon, or metal engraving.
Pose: upright relaxed-alert planted stance, near-side 3/4 facing right; full body centered; both feet visible.
Style/medium: genuine deliberately constructed pixel art, closely directed by the reference gameplay sprites. Effective 128x192 logical working grid enlarged 8x with nearest-neighbor-looking large UNIFORM square pixels. Character roughly 120–140 logical pixels tall. Compact blocky readable silhouette, clear stepped pixel edges, simple face marks, broad hair masses, bold sparse shadow shapes.
Color palette: indigo, charcoal, worn steel, a small rust accent, warm medium-light brown skin; approximately 20–30 colors total; flat 2–3 shade clusters per material.
Scene/backdrop: plain flat light-neutral background only; no gradient, vignette, soft shadow, scene, UI, labels, or text.
Lighting/mood: flat neutral light only.
Constraints: output 1024x1536 portrait. This must look like an actual small gameplay sprite enlarged for review, not a detailed fantasy illustration or portrait. One character only. No text.
Avoid: photorealism; adult anatomical illustration; realistic 6–8-head proportions; realistic muscle modeling; realistic lighting; pores; noise; pixel grain; dither; fine hair strands; soft rendering; anti-aliased tiny pixels; painterly texture; illustrative portrait; extra figures; copied identities, outfits, faces, HUD, or UI.
